# Source Serif 4 fixture

Unmodified static `OTF/SourceSerif4-Regular.otf` from Adobe's [4.005R desktop release](https://github.com/adobe-fonts/source-serif/releases/tag/4.005R), downloaded from its official `source-serif-4.005_Desktop.zip` asset.

SHA-256: `edf160d0d584deee8a3bb2c3371b2a7624ca63580fbe02c57c1f4c91e84d8787`.
The SIL Open Font License is retained in `LICENSE.md`. This source-only fixture is not embedded in distributed executables.
